items.title: DJ Moore: Practice status in question Thursday
items.text:
Moore (shoulder) was not participating during the media viewing period of Thursday's practice,  Sal Capaccio of WGR Sports Radio 550 Buffalo reports.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Not seen at practice Thursday
items.text:
Barkley (hamstring) wasn't present during the open portion of Thursday's practice, Tim McManus of ESPN reports.

items.title: DeVonta Smith: Logging some activity Thursday
items.text:

items.title: DJ Moore: Not ruled out for Week 5
items.text:
Head coach Joe Brady said Thursday that Moore (shoulder) is "going to be able to do everything he can to be able to rock this week," Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.
